notes.title: 04/18/2025 Update
notes.content:
Molly the intern cat had at work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524585/e1273a7f07a2fdd8e7afd591579560b355f8df06.jpg

Greetings, everyone,

We’d like to sincerely thank all of you who have supported Tarot since its launch on March 28th. As our studio’s debut title, it has been both exciting and rewarding to see players engaging with the game and sharing their experiences. Your early feedback and enthusiasm have been invaluable.
Today, we’re releasing a small update focused on improving the early-game experience and enhancing visual clarity:

Update Notes:


 All starting decks now include one healing card to provide greater balance during early encounters.

 A fire effect has been added to the selectable map component to improve visual feedback during navigation.



Looking ahead, we will be publishing a brief Google Form survey at the end of the month to gather structured player feedback. Your insights will play a key role in guiding future development and refinement of Tarot.

Thank you once again for your continued support.
— Knights of Terminus
